description: This file is a Perl module 'Error.pm' providing an object-oriented exception handling framework with classes like Error and Error::Simple, including exception catching, throwing, stack traces, and error propagation.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Base class for error objects supporting error information, object association, stack trace, and exception throwing.

classes.name: Error::Simple
classes.description: Subclass of Error for simple error messages containing text and optional value.

classes.name: Error::subs
classes.description: Provides subs for try/catch exception handling syntax.

classes.name: Error::WarnDie
classes.description: Handles warnings and die signals to produce verbose stack traces and formatted error output.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new error object, capturing call site information and generating stack trace if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: throw
methods.description: Throws the error object, causing exception handling or program termination.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Creates and returns a new error object with specified arguments; syntactic sugar.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Creates and returns a new error object; used for recording errors without throwing.

methods.name: stacktrace
methods.description: Returns detailed stack trace information if debugging; otherwise limited info.

methods.name: associate
methods.description: Associates an error with an object, enabling error propagation.

methods.name: object
methods.description: Returns the object associated with the error, if any.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Returns the filename where the error was created.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Returns the line number where the error was created.

methods.name: stringify
methods.description: Overload method converting the error object to string, typically returning the text message.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns an associated value with the error, if any.
